entries: Owner instruction 'Simulate the split test'. Companion and conditional noise fluke both called inconsistent about 1% of the time in either split: no power to separate them. Receiver split uninformative (430 MHz alone 0.44 us against a 0.089 us feature). Time split catches a one-half-only signal 78-99% of the time.
Simulated data only; no observed residuals read; no observed test run or authorized. Depends on the assumed red-noise model.
